label: llm-request nodes demo
info:
Demonstrates the llm-request node: the Ask row (top) is a plain LLM conversation, the Agent row (bottom) lets the LLM edit this flow.

SETUP:
1. Configure the LLM Plugin in the editor sidebar first (provider, API key if needed).
2. Set a model on both llm-request nodes (or pass msg.model).
3. Deploy, then click an inject button and watch the debug sidebar.

ASK ROW: sends msg.payload as the prompt and outputs the model's reply on msg.payload (plain text - do not JSON.parse it). No flows are selected, so it is a plain chat request; select flows on the node to send them as context.

AGENT ROW: asks the LLM to add a small inject -> debug pair to this tab. The change is applied LIVE in the open editor via the plugin's importer (an editor must be open), but NOTHING IS DEPLOYED automatically - review the canvas and click Deploy yourself, or undo with Ctrl+Z. For a fully automated Agent + Auto deploy loop, see the llm-self-feedback example instead.

STATUS: while a request runs the llm-request node shows a blue dot with the elapsed seconds, then green on success (done / sent to editor) or red on error or timeout. The timeout defaults to 3600 seconds (1 hour) because local LLMs can be slow; lower it on the node or via msg.timeout to fail fast.

Everything here (and everything the Agent prompt asks for) uses core nodes only, so the demo works on any Node-RED instance.

name: Ask: a question
payload: Explain what Node-RED is in one sentence.

name: Agent: build a flow
payload: Add an inject node wired to a debug node that logs the timestamp.
